text:
Steps:

Go to https://t.co/r1h6omJK2T

Then:
→ Open canvas
→ Use video node
→ Select Seedance 2.0
→ Change Duration and Layout
→ Generate the video

Done.

Seedance 2.0 prompt below 👇 https://t.co/rKKj67XX1I
content: Go to https://t.co/r1h6omJK2T, open canvas, add a video node, select Seedance 2.0, set Duration and Layout, then generate the video.

translations.es: Ve a https://t.co/r1h6omJK2T, abre el lienzo, añade un nodo de video, selecciona Seedance 2.0, establece la Duración y el Diseño, luego genera el video.
translations.fr: Allez sur https://t.co/r1h6omJK2T, ouvrez le canvas, ajoutez un nœud vidéo, sélectionnez Seedance 2.0, définissez la Durée et la Disposition, puis générez la vidéo.
translations.ja:
---
https://t.co/r1h6omJK2T にアクセスし、キャンバスを開き、ビデオノードを追加し、Seedance 2.0 を選択し、Duration と Layout を設定してからビデオを生成します。
---
translations.ko: https://t.co/r1h6omJK2T로 이동하여 캔버스를 열고, 비디오 노드를 추가한 후 Seedance 2.0을 선택하세요. Duration과 Layout을 설정한 다음, 비디오를 생성하세요.
translations.pt-BR: Vá para https://t.co/r1h6omJK2T, abra a tela, adicione um nó de vídeo, selecione Seedance 2.0, defina Duração e Layout, e então gere o vídeo.
translations.zh-CN: 请访问 https://t.co/r1h6omJK2T，打开画布，添加一个视频节点，选择 Seedance 2.0，设置 Duration 和 Layout，然后生成视频。
